label: Effective Lagrangian work published
description: Work with Dick and Marvin Friedman overcame soft pion approximation issues using effective Lagrangian method.

sources.quote: However, around 1967 an important issue arose which concerned the breakdown of the soft pion approximation... This problem was overcome in work with Dick and Marvin Friedman by giving up the soft pion approximation and using the eﬀective Lagrangian method

label: Axial current anomaly paper
description: Discovered axial current anomaly modifying PCAC condition.

sources.quote: However, in a paper in 1968 we discovered [26] that hard pion analysis also gave a vanishing π0 → 2γ decay.

label: XVII ICHEP Conference in London
description: Pran Nath attended conference where he became interested in supersymmetry.

sources.quote: It was in 1974 when I was at the XVII ICHEP Conference in London that I ﬁrst became interested in supersymmetry.

label: Formulation of gauge supersymmetry
description: Led to the formulation of gauge supersymmetry based on a single tensor superfield in superspace.

sources.quote: This lead to the formulation of gauge supersymmetry [52] based on a single tensor superﬁeld gΛΠ (z) in superspace

label: Sabbatical leave at CERN
description: Pran Nath was on sabbatical leave at CERN where he met Ali Chamseddine.

sources.quote: In 1980 I was on sabbatical leave at CERN and it was sheer good luck that I met Ali there.

label: Arrived in Boston
description: Ali Chamseddine arrived in Boston to work with Nath and Arnowitt.

sources.quote: Ali arrived in Boston in January of 1981.

label: SUGRA GUT analysis started
description: Analysis for supergravity grand unified model began in Fall 1981.

sources.quote: As mentioned our analysis started in the beginning of the Fall of 1981.

label: SUGRA GUT analysis completed
description: Construction of Lagrangian with arbitrary number of chiral fields completed.

sources.quote: This analysis was rather elaborate and took us up to the early spring of 1982 to complete.

label: SUGRA GUT published
description: Analyses published in Summer and Fall of 1982.

sources.quote: Our analyses to be published later in the Summer and Fall of 1982 [79–81] were based on the supergravity couplings contained in [78].
